supporting_observations.claim: FILE-HD-01 logged repeated failed network logons for svc-claimsync from 13:31 through 13:46 UTC. The attempts recur at roughly one-minute intervals and report bad-password status; the supplied environment context says the ClaimSync job runs every minute and its password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC.

Domain-controller records corroborate failed authentication for svc-claimsync from the FILE-HD-01 workstation during this period, including bad-password status in 4776 records and pre-authentication failure status in 4771 records.

At 13:39 UTC, WS-LPARK-01 recorded a SYSTEM process, GxCVD.exe, using explicit credentials for svc-claimsync with PROXY-HD-01 as the target server. This use is outside the service account's stated ClaimSync-on-FILE-HD-01 role and warrants investigation, but the record alone does not establish that authentication succeeded or that the activity was malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records end at 13:46 UTC, so they do not show authentication activity for the remainder of the requested window through 14:20 UTC.
The supplied records do not establish whether the explicit-credential use in T002-00019 succeeded; no matching proxy authentication outcome is provided.
The supplied records do not show the password-rotation completion time, when the ClaimSync job configuration was updated, or the job's execution details.
claims_not_established: That the repeated failures were caused by the scheduled password rotation and stale ClaimSync configuration, rather than another cause.
That svc-claimsync authentication from WS-LPARK-01 to PROXY-HD-01 succeeded or resulted in access.
That an unauthorized person obtained or used the svc-claimsync credential.
That svc-claimsync had any successful authentication during the supplied period.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy-HD-01 authentication and access logs around 13:39 UTC, including the outcome and any associated account or source details.
WS-LPARK-01 process, service, and endpoint telemetry for GxCVD.exe around 13:39 UTC, including process ancestry, command line, and configuration.
The password-rotation record and ClaimSync job configuration or execution history on FILE-HD-01 around 13:30–14:20 UTC.
Authentication success and failure records for svc-claimsync from all relevant hosts for the full requested window.
unrelated_findings: Separate inventory review: T002-00019 shows Commvault GxCVD.exe on WS-LPARK-01, while the supplied approved-software context identifies CobaltVault as the approved offsite backup agent. Treat the software/inventory discrepancy as a separate ticket; it does not by itself determine this alert.
